instruction.name: xvfcvt.h.s
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, convert single-precision floating point elements in the corresponding lane of `a` into the upper half and elements in `b` into the lower half, as half-precision floating point numbers.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 3.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvfcvt.h.s $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvfcvt.h.s $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvfcvt.h.s $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvfcvt.h.s $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvfcvt.h.s $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvfcvt.h.s $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvfcvt.h.s $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvfcvt.h.s $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
